preparedProtocol: tedious.prepare/execute/unprepare; same handle reused for all SPACE inputs

results.name: zero and signs
results.query: SELECT SPACE(0) AS a,SPACE(-1) AS b,SPACE(+3) AS c,SPACE(-(-3)) AS d

results.name: decimal counts
results.query: SELECT SPACE(2.9) AS a,SPACE(-0.9) AS b,SPACE(-2.9) AS c

results.name: null and cap
results.query: SELECT SPACE(NULL) AS a,SPACE(9000) AS b

results.name: dependent width
results.query: SELECT ISNULL(CASE WHEN 1=0 THEN SPACE(0) END,CHAR(65)) AS n,SPACE(0)+'x' AS s
